messages:
Anya L: Quick a11y/UX question — when folks navigate between the dashboard panels (Routes → Model details → Logs) keyboard focus is not preserved. VoiceOver jumps to the first focusable thing and keyboard users lose place. Thoughts on expected behavior?
Mike H: I agree we should preserve context. If the user triggered the panel via a keyboard, focus should land on the logical landmark or the element that represents that panel.
Jamal R: For panels that slide in/out, pattern is usually: set tabindex=\"-1\" on the panel container and call .focus() when it becomes active, and when closing return focus to the triggering control.
Devon K: +1. Also watch for focus trapping when there are nested interactive regions. If a panel has tabs inside, don't trap at the panel root.
Anya L: For switching between sibling panels (not modal close), do we restore last focused element inside that panel (focus memory) or always focus the panel headline?
Mike H: Prefer restoring last focused element per panel. Keyboard users expect where they left off. But if it's first visit, focus should go to panel heading.
Jamal R: Implementation note: keep a small map keyed by panel id that stores element selectors or a short path, update on blur/keydown. When opening, try to query that selector and focus if still present.
Devon K: Example snippet that worked for us:
```
// save
panelState[panelId] = document.activeElement?.getAttribute('data-a11y-id')
// restore
const selector = `[data-a11y-id=\"${panelState[panelId]}\"]`
const el = panelRoot.querySelector(selector) || panelRoot.querySelector('.panel-heading')
el?.focus()
```
Anya L: Nice — we should standardize `data-a11y-id` for ephemeral controls. I'll add to the design tokens doc.
Mike H: Also noticed a related SR issue: when a panel collapses we currently don't announce the new summary state to screen readers. Suggest adding an aria-live=\"polite\" region for panel state changes or using aria-expanded on the trigger button.
Jamal R: Use aria-expanded on the trigger + aria-controls linking to the panel. For optional extra announce, a visually-hidden <div aria-live=\"polite\"> can surface like "Logs panel collapsed". Keep it brief.
Devon K: Lighthouse check I ran throws a couple of automated fails:
lighthouse-bot: ⚠️ 2 issues found: 1) Low contrast: .card .muted-text has contrast 2.9:1 (target 4.5:1). 2) Focus visible not meeting 3px ring requirement on .icon-button.
Anya L: Thanks — contrast fix is urgent for any status/error text. We prefer 4.5:1 for body copy. Can design propose new color tokens that meet AA?
Mike H: I'll update color tokens: swap muted-text to gray-600 (we tested and it's 4.6:1 on white). For focus-visible add a 3px outline using accent-500 at 30% overlay on dark bg.
Jamal R: Small ARIA nit: the cog icon used for route settings currently has title=\"Settings\" but no aria-label and role is missing. Add `role=\"button\" aria-label=\"Route settings\" aria-expanded=\"false\"` and toggle aria-expanded when open.
Devon K: Re: keyboard nav, ensure arrow keys aren't hijacked unless it's a true composite widget. The dashboard cards respond to left/right for carousel — but they are not roving tab-index based. We should either expose as a widget with correct roving behavior or remove arrow handlers.
Anya L: Good call. For now remove arrow handlers from plain cards and schedule a roving-tabindex pattern for the card list if we need arrow nav.
Mike H: Proposed action items:
- Anya: draft small a11y checklist for panel patterns + define `data-a11y-id` (due Tue)
- Devon: implement focus memory + aria-expanded toggles, add tiny aria-live for collapse announcements (PR by Wed)
- Jamal: update interactive icon roles and audit arrow key handlers (PR by Thu)
- Mike: color tokens PR for muted text + focus visible styles (end of week)
Anya L: I'll also run quick NVDA + VoiceOver pass on mac/Windows once the PRs land.
lighthouse-bot: ✅ Automated scan note: re-run after color + focus updates. Remaining programmatic issues will be listed if detected.
Devon K: I'll add unit tests that assert elements that get focused have tabindex rules and that aria-expanded toggles when open/close are triggered.
Anya L: Thanks all — this thread helps a lot. I'll drop a short spec in #design-docs and tag folks. :thumbsup:
Mike H: Thanks! :rocket:
